game.name: Star Wars Episode I: Racer
game.rules:
- Video is required.
- On PC, the following releases are permitted: Original CD version, GoG, Steam or Origin port. The Community Multiplayer Mod, while discouraged, is allowed for submissions providing it does not affect the speedrun, but any runs using it will be subject to greater scrutiny. The game must otherwise be unmodified.
- PC specific: the save state tool is allowed for practice purposes, but is not permitted for submitted runs.
- PC specific: Framerate must be capped between 24 and 60 FPS. Switching the framerate mid-run is not allowed.

## Skips

For a list of skips, see: https://www.speedrun.com/swe1r/thread/pq7q4

Skips Definition

1. A strategy is a skip if it REDUCES DISTANCE TRAVELLED by any one of the following methods:

- Going out of bounds (oob), which is defined by initiating the game's 
internal oob timer. An oob region does not count if it is unavoidable or
part of the track spline.
- Clipping through a wall or object that has collision (from any 
direction).
- Triggering a lap some place other than the start-finish line.  

2. A strategy may also be deemed a skip if it REDUCES DISTANCE TRAVELLED and is judged by the moderators to be a skip using various principles. See https://www.speedrun.com/swe1r/thread/pq7q4 for more details.

3. If a strategy requires triggering a Maximum Fall Glitch (MFG), or using 
the AI to load portions of track, then it is an MFG/AI skip.

4. A strategy that enables a recovery from a mistake is not a skip, as long 
as it does not cut less distance than not making the mistake in the first
place.

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
- Get to the credits by beating all seven Galactic Circuit courses on a new save file in tournament mode.
- Timing starts when selecting "ok" to create a new file and ends when crossing the finish line of the Boonta Classic.
- For the PC version: use the Autosplitter provided on the resources page, change your timing method in LiveSplit to ingame time. This will get you the loadless time of your run. Submit that time to the real time field.
- You may have menu options pre-selected from another file (the game does not reset options in a session even after deleting a file).
- You are not required to win every race. You just need at least 4th place in the first 6 races (to unlock the next ones) and 3rd in the last one (to trigger the credits).

categories.name: 3 Lap
categories.rules:
*IMPORTANT: You need to show the time displayed AFTER the race, not during the race. The game only shows times as .00x during the race and rounds them later. You can either include it in the video or with a screenshot.*
 
- Pausing the game during an IL is not allowed
- You may play on any game mode except console 2 player.
- You may play with AI present.
- You may play on mirror mode.
- Runs without upgrades have to show the stats of the podracer to prove that no upgrades were used.

categories.name: 1 Lap
categories.rules:
*IMPORTANT: You need to show the time displayed AFTER the race, not during the race. The game only shows times as .00x during the race and rounds them later. You can either include it in the video or with a screenshot.*
 
Fast Lap Rules:
- Using the save state tool to setup a flap or build up speed is not allowed.

IL Rules:
- Pausing the game during an IL is not allowed (you can still pause before or after your 1lap IL).
- You may play on any game mode except console 2 player.
- You may play with AI present.
- You may play on mirror mode.
- Runs without upgrades have to show the stats of the podracer to prove that no upgrades were used.

- Win all 25 races on a new save file in tournament mode.
- Timing starts when selecting "ok" to create a new file and ends when crossing the finish line of the final race.
- For the PC version: use the Autosplitter provided on the resources page, change your timing method in LiveSplit to ingame time. This will get you the loadless time of your run. Submit that time to the real time field.
- You may have menu options pre-selected from another file (the game does not reset options in a session even after deleting a file).
- You may reset the game to skip the credits and the podium cutscenes.

categories.name: Amateur Circuit
categories.rules:

- Timing starts when selecting "ok" to create a new file and ends when crossing the finish line of Spice Mine Run.
- For the PC version: use the Autosplitter provided on the resources page, change your timing method in LiveSplit to ingame time. This will get you the loadless time of your run. Submit that time to the real time field.
- You may have menu options pre-selected from another file (the game does not reset options in a session even after deleting a file).
- You are not required to win every race. You just need at least 4th place in the first 6 races (to unlock the next ones) and 3rd in the last one (to trigger the podium cutscene).

categories.name: Semi-Pro Circuit
categories.rules:

- You are not required to win every race. You just need at least 4th place in the first 6 races (to unlock the next ones) and 3rd in the last one (to trigger the podium cutscene).

categories.name: All Tracks NG+
categories.rules:
- Complete all 25 tracks from an existing save file.
- Timing starts when selecting "Start race" for the first track and ends when crossing the finish line of the last track.
- For the PC version: use the Autosplitter provided on the resources page, change your timing method in LiveSplit to ingame time. This will get you the loadless time of your run. Submit that time to the real time field.
- You may play on any game mode except console 2 player.
- You may switch game modes mid-run.
- You may play with AI present.
- You may play on mirror mode.
- All races must be set to 3 laps.
- Runs without upgrades have to show the stats of the podracer to prove that no upgrades were used.

categories.name: All Tracks NG+, Track Favorites
categories.rules:
- Complete all 25 tracks from an existing save file while using the track favorite for each track.
- Timing starts when selecting "Start race" for the first track and ends when crossing the finish line of the last track.
- For the PC version: use the Autosplitter provided on the resources page, change your timing method in LiveSplit to ingame time. This will get you the loadless time of your run. Submit that time to the real time field.
- You may play on any game mode except console 2 player.
- You may switch game modes mid-run.
- You may play with AI present.
- You may play on mirror mode.
- All races must be set to 3 laps.
- Runs without upgrades have to show the stats of the podracer to prove that no upgrades were used.

categories.name: All Tracks NG+, One Character
categories.rules:
*The purpose of this category is to give runners the option to do runs with any character they may want to. It is therefore encouraged to do runs with characters other than the fastest ones, and it is encouraged to submit several runs with different characters.*
 
- Complete all 25 tracks from an existing save file while using only one character.
- Timing starts when selecting "Start race" for the first track and ends when crossing the finish line of the last track.
- For the PC version: use the Autosplitter provided on the resources page, change your timing method in LiveSplit to ingame time. This will get you the loadless time of your run. Submit that time to the real time field.
- You may play on any game mode except console 2 player.
- You may switch game modes mid-run.
- You may play with AI present.
- You may play on mirror mode.
- All races must be set to 3 laps.
- Runs without upgrades have to show the stats of the podracer to prove that no upgrades were used.

categories.name: Any% VMU Manipulation
categories.rules:
*This category is only applicable for Dreamcast No Upgrades*
 
- Timing starts when entering a new save file in Free Play and ends when the podium cutscene after Boonta Classic appears.
- There must be no SWE1R save files on the VMU before the run
- The console must be visibly reset in the submitted video before the start of the run
- Video is required
